actions.desc: The mage is a 9th-level spellcaster. Its spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 14, +6 to hit with spell attacks). The mage has the following wizard spells prepared:   Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, light, mage hand, prestidigitation  1st level (4 slots): detect magic, mage armor, magic missile, shield  2nd level (3 slots): misty step, suggestion  3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, fireball, fly  4th level (3 slots): greater invisibility, ice storm  5th level (1 slot): cone of cold
